card.name: Words just before a predictable next word
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or gaps in drug-label text where the next word is highly predictable, such as the space after a number range, "been" before "reported", or "see" before a cross-reference.

modes.label: Gaps after numbers
modes.description: The space or break between a number and the next number or table reference.

modes.label: Linking words before reported
modes.description: The word "been" right before "reported" in adverse-event sentences.
modes.example: cataracts have<< been>> reported following the use of long-term administration

modes.label: Partway through list or phrase
modes.description: A comma, abbreviation letter or short word inside a set phrase.
modes.example: exposes users to the risks of addiction, abuse<<,>> and misuse
